decision_rule: As in R2-A. Corrected = the value adds a fact the cited page does not show, tags a judgement as stated, places a company-level fact at the plant, ties a posting or fact to the plant through a location shared by several sites (campus rule, consultation 10), or the quote is not on the page (raw source, incl. JSON-LD, checked before calling a quote missing); also an inferred relationship that breaks the written mining relationship rule. Confirmed otherwise. Not additive: limiting parentheticals ('company-level', 'site split not stated', 'not counted'), provenance labels, and a site-tie premise in a posting row ('PPI's only Lenox location', 'the company's only facility') when a page opened today carries it (PPI's ADP board location facet; West River's About page 'our facility in Oakwood, Virginia'). An EPA name/address row whose value only restates the EPA record is confirmed; where no cited page ties the EPA facility to the operator, that is reported as a lead or limit unless the value asserts the tie (Tabor precedent). Postings: re-read live today on the employer's own board; site named on the board or text; counting checked against the session-2 labor rule, the standing-ad rule (consultation 12) and the undated/aggregator rules.
